profile_text.body:
Lumen Technologies, Inc. is a public company that trades as LUMN and is headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, with CIK 0000018926. On its own site it describes itself as providing secure networking, edge cloud and AI-ready infrastructure over a global fiber network, and calls itself the enterprise-ready backbone of the AI economy. It says its network reach and simplified architecture are designed to support AI workloads across high-bandwidth and multicloud connections.

The site offers customer examples. For Arctic Glacier it says built-in automation replaced manual operations. For the New York Yankees it describes programmable, consumption-based networking with diverse 100G paths and automatic failover between Yankee Stadium and digital operations facilities in Tampa. For American Family Care, an urgent care provider it says was scaling across 26 states, it cites network outages, dropped calls and manual payment flows as the problems addressed. For Prometheus Hyperscale it says it built a private, low-latency network for heavy AI workloads, and that Prometheus anticipates cutting power consumption by 50% while keeping performance steady. In retail it points to security for transactions and protection from DDoS attacks.

Litigation exposure is recorded in Louisiana, with 57 matters.
